_about: Where each theme concept belongs (plan 7.6b). Copilot's theme map (out/theme-map.json) is left as drawn; this file says where a concept is shown. `home`: the one theme whose page holds it; `also`: the sibling themes that link to it. A concept not listed stays in the theme Copilot gave it. Doug, 2026-10-06: 'some overlap is ok - but strive to put things in their logical place'; group 5's three themes approved on docs/review/THEME-HOMES-GROUP5.html ('approved'). `why`: the reason it moves, or why its title is to be reviewed. `names`: a theme's new display name, with the name it replaced; the id and address never change.

apocalyptic:6.why: moves: judgment of nations is Judgment's subject; the visions show it, so Apocalyptic links to it

apocalyptic:7.why: label to review: "vindication" names an outcome; the texts' own words (Dan 12, Rev 6:10) may say it better

apocalyptic:8.why: moves: "the day of the LORD" is the prophets' phrase (Joel, Amos, Zephaniah, Malachi)

apocalyptic:9.why: moves: the Messiah's victory is Messiah's subject

apocalyptic:10.why: moves: final judgment to Judgment; resurrection is linked from New Creation

apocalyptic:11.why: moves: and may repeat New Creation's own "Renewal of Heaven and Earth" and "Eternal State" -- one thing recorded twice is merged only on your word

prophetic_word:11.why: moves, and label to review: "Fulfillment in Jesus Christ" states the Christian reading as the site's; the texts that say "to fulfill what was spoken" can carry it in their own words

prophetic_word:12.why: label to review: with c13 it takes a side on a live dispute -- whether prophecy continues (Pentecostal, charismatic) or ceased (cessationist)

law_wisdom:5.why: moves (Doug, 2026-10-07: 'if we do move wisdom fully to wisdom literature, the law is a huge topic'; on the card, 'The Law'): wisdom is Wisdom Literature's subject; The Law links to it

law_wisdom:7.why: stays: the bridge, in the texts' words ('Fear God and keep His commandments'); Wisdom Literature links to it

wisdom_literature:9.why: stays: wisdom's side of the bridge; The Law links to it

apocalyptic:4.why: moves (P-2026-10-07-2, Doug: approved): Cosmic Conflict is Spiritual Warfare's core; the visions show it, so Apocalyptic links to it

deliverance:9.why: moves (the card for P-2026-10-07-3, Doug: 'Split into two'): Liberation / Freedom is Freedom's core; Deliverance links to it

prophetic_word.name: Prophets and Prophecy
prophetic_word.why: Whether a word was fulfilled is what traditions read differently; the texts that say 'to fulfill what was spoken' stay on the page in their own words. Doug: 'make sure you get the Prophetic Word renamed everywhere including in the Apocalyptic card' (P-2026-10-06-14)

messiah.name: Messiah
messiah.why: 'Christology' is a term of doctrine, and the theme's pages set out the titles in the texts' own words. Doug, asked whether to rename it now rather than in the final names pass: 'Rename now'

law_wisdom.name: The Law
law_wisdom.why: Wisdom moved fully to Wisdom Literature, and the Law is a subject of its own: the Torah, the Sermon on the Mount, the first part of Romans. The front page keeps the bridge to wisdom in the texts' words. Doug: 'rethinking: if we do move wisdom fully to wisdom literature, the law is a huge topic'; 'it could still connect to wisdom on the card to present a bridge and retain the url'; on the card, 'Yes: The Law'

_site_shown: The site's own themes (ontology/themes/site-themes.md) shown on the site: each added only when its owner has seen it (plan 7.6b). Until then the server hides it everywhere; the preview shows it.
